steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: E-commerce allows businesses to sell online 24/7, reaching a global market with lower overhead costs than a physical shop. | Key Fact: Digital communication (email, video conferencing, social media) speeds up decision-making and enables remote/flexible working. | Key Fact: Automation and robotics increase productivity and consistency but reduce unskilled jobs and require high capital investment. | Key Fact: EPOS (Electronic Point of Sale) tracks sales in real time, manages stock levels automatically, and provides data for marketing decisions.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two ways e-commerce has changed how businesses sell to customers. | Analyse the impact of automation on a manufacturing business and its workers. | Evaluate whether a small retail business should invest in an online store.
